fields.name: 32_Interest_rate_type
fields.definition:
* Fixed - plain vanilla fixed coupon rate
* Floating - plain vanilla floating coupon rates (for all interest rates, which refer to a reference interest rate like EONIA or EURIBOR + margin in BP)
* Variable - all other variable interest rates like step-up or step-down or fixed-to-float bonds. The variable feature is the (credit) margin or the change between fixed and float.
* Infation_linked for inflation linked bonds in order to identify them.

fields.name: 33_Coupon_rate
fields.definition:
Fixed rate: coupon rate as a percentage of nominal amount
Floating rate: last fixing rate + margin as a percentage of nominal amount
Variable rate: estimation of current rate over the period + margin as a percentage of nominal amount
all rates are expressed on an annual basis
